sql: SELECT id,email,role,admin_permissions,status FROM users WHERE id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments d WHERE TRUE AND d.name ILIKE $1 ESCAPE E'\\'

WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.id,d.organization_key,d.name,d.status,d.sort_order,d.version,d.created_at,d.updated_at FROM departments d WHERE TRUE AND d.name ILIKE $1 ESCAPE E'\\' ORDER BY d.organization_key,d.sort_order,d.id LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3)
         SELECT d.id,d.organization_key,d.name,d.status,d.sort_order,d.version,d.created_at,d.updated_at,COUNT(u.id),COUNT(u.id) FILTER(WHERE u.status='active') FROM page d
         LEFT JOIN users u ON u.department_id=d.id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND CASE
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'xunyou.com' THEN 'xunyou'
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'wsdashi.com' THEN 'wsdashi'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END=d.organization_key
         GROUP BY d.id,d.organization_key,d.name,d.status,d.sort_order,d.version,d.created_at,d.updated_at ORDER BY d.organization_key,d.sort_order,d.id

Plans.Hash Cond: ((u.department_id = d.id) AND (CASE WHEN (lower(split_part((u.email)::text, '@'::text, 2)) = 'xunyou.com'::text) THEN 'xunyou'::text WHEN (lower(split_part((u.email)::text, '@'::text, 2)) = 'wsdashi.com'::text) THEN 'wsdashi'::text ELSE 'other'::text END = (d.organization_key)::text))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id=u.department_id AND d.organization_key=CASE
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'xunyou.com' THEN 'xunyou'
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'wsdashi.com' THEN 'wsdashi'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.email ILIKE $1 ESCAPE E'\\'

SELECT u.id,u.email,u.username,u.status,CASE
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'xunyou.com' THEN 'xunyou'
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'wsdashi.com' THEN 'wsdashi'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END,d.id,COALESCE(d.name,''),u.department_version FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id=u.department_id AND d.organization_key=CASE
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'xunyou.com' THEN 'xunyou'
                    WHEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(u.email, '@', 2)) = 'wsdashi.com' THEN 'wsdashi'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.email ILIKE $1 ESCAPE E'\\' ORDER BY u.id LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
